validator.result: FAILED — 16 problems, 5 warnings, all 16 problems from one check
validator.note: Every one of the 16 failures is check [4 badges] 'host matches nothing in badge_map'. Eight are pre-existing rows u011-u018 on brownfieldagnews.com, added by the 18 August run; eight are this run's Pro Farmer rows v007-v014 on profarmer.com. This is a standing disagreement between validate.py and STEP 7 of the run instructions, not a defect introduced here: STEP 7 says an unmapped host is badged Press and appended to index/unmapped_domains.json, which is exactly what was done, while validate.py treats any unmapped host as a hard failure. The instructions also forbid the run from editing badge_map.json, because moving a domain between badges is a human decision taken between runs. So the run cannot clear this failure and must not try. A human adding brownfieldagnews.com and profarmer.com to badge_map.json clears all 16 at once. Every other check — claim keys, series, flags, shards against all.json, summary shape, run_state — passed.
